Author: P.Sree Sudha
Bench: P.Sree Sudha
The Honourable Smt. Justice P.Sree Sudha
 M.A.C.M.A.No.3097 of 2009
J U D G M E N T:

This Motor Accident Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act,
1989 against the Judgment and Decree dated 18.02.2009 passed in O.P.No.385 of 2007 passed by the learned Chairman, Motor Vehicles Accidents Claims Tribunal, Nalgonda.

entities.text: Motor Vehicles Accidents Claims Tribunal, Nalgonda
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 02. The Original Petition in O.P.No.385 of 2007 was filed by appellants/petitioners claiming compensation of Rs.2,50,000/- for death of their child Chittireddy Monalisa, (here-in-after referred as 'deceased'), who died in the motor vehicle accident occurred on 21.12.2006.
Appellant No.1 is the mother and appellant No.2 is the father of the deceased.
The trial Court after considering the arguments of both sides, granted compensation only to an extent of Rs.50,000/-.
Aggrieved by the said Judgment and decree, they preferred the present appeal.
03. As the present appeal is preferred only for enhancement of the compensation amount granted by the trial Court, this Court is not going into other details.

04. As per the guidelines of the Honourable Apex Court in dictum of Meena Devi v. Nunu Chand Mahto alias Nemchand Mahto and others,1 wherein the child of 12 years, died in road accident, the Honourable Apex Court considered several Judgments and granted an amount of Rs.5,00,000/-.

entities.text: Meena Devi v. Nunu Chand Mahto alias Nemchand Mahto and others,1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is also held that the Tribunal/Court ought to award 'just' compensation and less valuation, if any,
made in the claim petition would not be impediment to award just compensation exceeding the claimed amount.

05. In view of the above, this Court relying on the ratio laid down by the Honourable Apex Court,
feels it reasonable to award an amount of Rs.5,00,000/- to the appellant towards compensation.

06. Accordingly, this Motor Accident Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is allowed by enhancing the AIR 2022 Supreme Court 5006 compensation amount from Rs.50,000/- to Rs.05,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakhs only) with interest at the rate of 7.5% per annum from the date of filing the petition till date of realization.

Respondent Nos.1 and 2 are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation amount and Respondent No.2/Insurance Company shall deposit the entire amount within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this Judgment.
On such deposit, the appellant is entitled to withdraw the said amount along with interest accrued thereon.
Appellants are directed to pay the deficit Court fee on the enhanced amount.
There shall be no order as to costs.
